statement.p: Determine whether {\bf r}_1 and {\bf r}_2 collide or intersect:

The two paths
collide
do not collide

The two paths
intersect
do not intersect

static.solution:
t such that:
\left\lt t,t^2,t^3 \right> = \left\lt -\left(5t+1.33333\right), 36t^{2},8 \right>
Equating corresponding components we obtain the following equations:
t=-\left(5t+1.33333\right)
t^2=36t^{2}
t^3=8
The second equation implies that t=0, but this value does not satisfy the other equations. Therefore, the equations have no solution, which means that the paths do not collide.
The two paths intersect if there exist values of t and s such that:
\left\lt s,s^2,s^3 \right> = \left\lt -\left(5t+1.33333\right), 36t^{2},8 \right>
Or equivalently:
s=-\left(5t+1.33333\right)
s^2=36t^{2}
s^3=8
The second equation implies that s=\pm 6 t, and the third equation implies s=2. Hence t=\pm 0.333333333333333
We can see that both solutions don't satisfy the first equation, hence the two paths do not intersect.
